title: FulltextAdjudication
description: Whether the shown passages state that the paper itself contains each part of one inclusion criterion. This is a proposal: the application decides, from two independent runs of this step, and only after it has found every quote on the page it showed. One entry per given part, by its name.

parts.description: One entry per part of the criterion, each named exactly once.

part.description: The part's name, copied from the criterion.

label.description: present: a shown passage states that the paper itself contains the part. absent: the passages describe what the paper does and this part is not among it. unclear: the passages do not say, including when the part could be on a page that was not shown.

quote.description: One continuous span copied from the named passage, character for character. Filled only when the label is present; empty otherwise. The application looks the span up on the page it showed.

passage_id.description: The passage the quote was copied from. Null unless the label is present.
